archetype: The Performance Pro (Security Command Center Adaptation)

headings.usage: Main dashboard headers, page titles, major metrics

body_and_stats.usage: Data tables, timestamps, camera IDs, accuracy percentages, logs

layouts.dashboard_grid: Mode B High Density Grid. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 or 12-col bento. gap-4 or gap-6.
layouts.sidebar: Left-aligned fixed sidebar for navigation with high-contrast active states.
layouts.live_camera_feed: Hero grid item: col-span-full lg:col-span-8 row-span-2. Needs 'Tracing Beam' effect for active status.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Flat Solid surfaces with 1px border-white/10 and sharp/md corners (max 6px). NO pure glassmorphism (distracts from camera feeds).
visual_enhancers.bounding_boxes: Absolute positioned divs with 2px borders matching status (Green for known, Red for unknown) with a small info tag (JetBrains Mono) anchored to top-left.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle CRT or noise overlay on empty camera states to reinforce security terminal vibe.

component_instructions.buttons: Sharp/md corners, hover states must shift background color slightly lighter or add subtle neon glow box-shadow.
component_instructions.cards: border border-white/10 bg-[#121212] rounded-md. Hover: border-white/20.
component_instructions.tables: Dense, monospace fonts for data cells. Hover effect on rows (`hover:bg-[#1A1A1A]`).
component_instructions.registration_wizard: Shadcn Steps/Tabs but highly customized to dark theme. Visual guidance using SVG outlines over camera feed.

motion.live_feed: Subtle pulsing dot (Red or Green) to indicate 'LIVE'.
motion.alerts: Unknown face alerts must slide in using Sonner with a red border.

accessibility.contrast: Text must pass APCA/WCAG standards against #0A0A0A and #121212.

media.icons_library: Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) for dense, professional dashboards.

instructions_to_main_agent: IMPORTANT: DO NOT USE TYPESCRIPT (.tsx/.ts). Write all components in standard JavaScript (.jsx/.js).
Build the dashboard emphasizing a high-tech security command center layout. Use deep black/obsidian backgrounds with true gray cards.
Implement the live recognition feed layout with overlay elements for bounding boxes that have absolute positioning.
Ensure all interactive and key informational elements include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid='login-button'`).
For the Face Registration Wizard, use a step-by-step layout with clear visual pose guidance instructions.
Avoid generic 'blue' SaaS vibes. Stick to the aggressive contrast of Green/Red/White on Black.
DO NOT center align the app container in App.css. Let the flex/grid layouts dictate alignment.
NEVER use fully transparent backgrounds for overlays, dropdowns, or modals. Always use #121212 or #1A1A1A.
Apply precise text sizing: max text-4xl for main headers, use JetBrains Mono for data points/tables.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and subtle borders.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations. Static = dead.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (transition: all). Always add transitions for specific properties.
Always use modern button styles (sharp/md corners) with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💭💡) for icons. Use the specified icon library.
NEVER use placeholder URLs (via.placeholder.com). Use the provided image URLs in the media section.
Use pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable, customize them for the dark aesthetic.
